summary: Humacyte filed an 8-K reporting entry into an underwriting agreement for a $1.05/share common stock offering of 47.6M shares (firm) plus a 30-day option for 7.1M more, expected to close June 12, 2026, using an effective shelf registration statement. Net proceeds ~$46.8M ($53.85M if option exercised). This is a routine equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change. The offering provides liquidity for operations. No deal terms are applicable.
